[SWS_SM_00618] StateMachine service interfaces - Offer
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
Each configured ara::com based service (
StateMachineService
,
StateMachi-
neNotification
) for the
StateMachine
to be started shall be available (offered)
when the
ActionListItem
"StartStateMachine" is processed successfully.
⌋
Please note that see [SWS_SM_00618] allows the
SMControlApplication
the pos-
sibility to request a new
StateMachine State
transition immediately after the suc-
cessful
StateMachine
creation, even if the
StateMachine
is processing the initial
ActionList
.
